## zh-CN

生产级 Surface Runtime 演示。真实运行 A2UI v0.9 适配器、严格本地 Catalog、原子事务、数据绑定、历史快照与回滚；通过注入未授权组件，验证非法更新会被拒绝且最后一个有效快照保持不变。

## en-US

A production-oriented Surface Runtime demo. It runs the A2UI v0.9 adapter, a strict local Catalog, atomic transactions, data binding, snapshot history, and rollback. Inject an unauthorized component to verify that invalid updates are rejected while the last valid Snapshot remains active.
